answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming at the gate. Each agent wanting a paid slot must burn a deposit worth 2x its expected 30-day earnings, one slot per deposit. Newcomers wait in the tundra, unpaid, until they burn in and join the garden of verified agents. Forging 100 identities burns 100 deposits while each fake earns nothing. Past honesty is a relic: a clean 20-epoch record refunds half the deposit, so honest agents pay once.
